notes.title: Hey Groupees! Want free games? (anyone else too) - Wrong Dimension Giveaway
notes.content:
Hey Groupee buyers! First off, thank you for voting for Wrong Dimension. 

We will be running a promotion where you can earn some free games (list below) by helping spread the word about Wrong Dimension. There are 3 ways to earn one of the game listed below.

1: Stream! Stream yourself playing the game and post the link to the video here! (or send a link to @StartUp_Studios) and post about it on Twitter! Doing this will help get exposure for this unique game of ours. I will pick 5 winners randomly from the streamers and they will get their choice of game.*

2: Speedruns! Wrong Dimension was designed for those that enjoy speedruns, and is built around learning the pattern of the levels. If you learn the pattern, you can beat the levels pretty quickly. Simple post on Twitter (tag @StartUp_Studios) or here and link to your speedrun. The 3 fastest speedruns will get their choice of a game.*

3: Forum posts! Some of you are part of communities that have members that would enjoy Wrong Dimension. I will pick 2 people who help spread the word of Wrong Dimension to those such people. Post a link to your post on Twitter/here!

Thanks for reading and I hope that you enjoy the game and help spread the word! 

List of the games:
The Banner Saga
WWE 2K16
Call of Duty®: Black Ops III - Multiplayer Starter Pack
The Incredible Adventures of Van Helsing: Final Cut
The Jackbox Party Pack 2
Kentucky Route Zero
Octodad: Dadliest Catch
Super Time Force Ultra
Nidhogg
Broken Age
Her Story
Rocket League
Mad Max
Gods Will Be Watching
South Park: The Stick of Truth
SpeedRunners
XSplit Premium 3-Month License 

* - First come first serve! Those that contact me with their choice first while get first choice. Please give me a second and third choice as well. -Mike
